commonStyle: Create ONE square editorial illustration for a small article idea tile, 1:1 composition. Match the site's accepted main images: realistic finely drawn people, premium painterly gouache, subtle natural texture, clean contours, lovely luminous daylight, cobalt blue clothing, restrained green and warm amber accents. More painterly and lifelike than a flat cartoon, not glossy 3D. The subject and key object must read immediately at 90–144 pixels. Crop close, fill most of the square, simple silhouette, minimal supporting environment. TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with a softly irregular painterly vignette around the subject and a little local grounding; no rectangular scenic backdrop, no frame, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no watermark. Natural correct hands/anatomy. Topic:
